label: Brânză de burduf
note: Made from caş dospit (matured sweet curd), cut, salted and kneaded by hand; fir bark gives a resin taste. Softer fattier versions: brânză de putină, Cremă Focșani.

about.text: Brânză de burduf is a salty Romanian cheese made from sheep, or occasionally buffalo, milk. The matured curd is kneaded with salt and packed into a sheep stomach, a sheep skin or a tube of pine bark.
